alternatives.whyRejected: `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` rejects `DBNull.Value` on a `SqlDbType.Structured` parameter with `NotSupportedException` before any SQL is sent to the server.

alternatives.option: Pass an empty `List<SqlDataRecord>` through to the parameter.
alternatives.whyRejected: `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` rejects a zero-element `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` with `ArgumentException` because zero records cannot supply TDS column metadata; the driver requires a `null` reference for an empty TVP.

alternatives.option: Throw `ArgumentException` when the caller supplies an empty collection.
alternatives.whyRejected: An empty collection is a valid domain value (for example, a parent entity with no child rows). Throwing forces every caller and attribute-mapped model to special-case empty collections.

alternatives.option: Omit the parameter from the `SqlParameterCollection` when the collection is empty.
alternatives.whyRejected: Changes the parameter collection shape between empty and non-empty invocations, breaks attribute-driven mapping that configures `TypeName` on the appended parameter, and fails for parameterized SQL text statements that reference the parameter name.

alternatives.option: Materialize lazy `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` sequences into a `List<SqlDataRecord>` at parameter-construction time.
alternatives.whyRejected: Defeats streaming for large inputs and corrupts data when a `yield` iterator reuses a single mutable `SqlDataRecord` instance across iterations.

alternatives.option: Peek the first element of a lazy `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` when the parameter is added.
alternatives.whyRejected: Opens and holds the source enumerator at parameter-addition time rather than command-execution time, complicating enumerator disposal and command retries.

fields.consequences: Null and empty collections added via `AddSqlTableValuedParameter` (and `[MapToSqlTableValuedParameter]`) execute cleanly and arrive at SQL Server as an empty table-valued parameter. Callers streaming a custom lazy `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` that does not implement `ICollection<SqlDataRecord>` or `IReadOnlyCollection<SqlDataRecord>` must ensure the sequence yields at least one record or pass `null`, as `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` rejects an empty unbuffered enumerator at execution time.
fields.context: `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` validates `SqlDbType.Structured` (table-valued) parameter values on the client at command execution time: `DBNull.Value` throws `NotSupportedException`, and a zero-element `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` throws `ArgumentException` because no record is present to supply TDS column metadata, whereas `Value = null` executes and is observed by SQL Server as an empty table for both stored procedures and parameterized SQL text commands. Meanwhile, the raw `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` overload serves as the streaming path that the driver enumerates once at execution time.
fields.decision: Every `AddSqlTableValuedParameter` overload appends the `SqlDbType.Structured` input parameter unconditionally and sets `Value = null` whenever the supplied collection is `null` or produces zero rows. For the streaming `IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>` overload, `null` and any collection implementing `ICollection<SqlDataRecord>` or `IReadOnlyCollection<SqlDataRecord>` with `Count == 0` are normalized to `Value = null` without enumerating, while non-collection lazy sequences are passed through unbuffered for single-pass driver enumeration at execution time.
fields.title: Represent a zero-row table-valued parameter as a null reference
